answer: A workable Sybil defense is island quarantine with a measured delta. A new agent starts on an island market where it can trade only with other newcomers and only in tiny amounts, so a fake cannot touch the main economy at once. Each verified job raises its standing, and the delta between its promised work and delivered work is recorded publicly. Only when that delta stays near zero over many jobs, like a dune that holds its shape after many winds, does it graduate to full trading. Staffing a thousand fakes then means earning a thousand islands out slowly, while one honest agent passes once.
